title: Repairing Harm
description: This course teaches participants how to acknowledge harm, take responsibility, and engage in meaningful repair.
learningOutcomes: Understand what meaningful repair looks like.
Recognise the impact of harm on others.
Learn how to apologise safely and respectfully.

modules.title: Understanding Harm
modules.content: Explores emotional, relational, and psychological harm.

modules.title: Repair Tools
modules.content: Provides strategies for safe, meaningful repair.
